title: Networking and Communication Technology
modules: Local Area Network And Wide Area
mcq: Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the connection of two or more private computer networks via a common routing technology (OSI Layer 3) using routers."
An internetwork is the connection of two or more private computer networks via a common routing technology (OSI Layer 3) using routers.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is defined by various communication protocols."
Actual communication is defined by various communication protocols.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are those that are not defined with any of the standard requirements."
Miscellaneous requirements are those that are not defined with any of the standard requirements.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a specialised and problem-oriented language."
A DSL is a specialised and problem-oriented language.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the process of facilitating the transfer of information over a medium."
Modulation is the process of facilitating the transfer of information over a medium.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the physical and logical interface between NT1 and NT2, whenever the two NTs are implemented as separate pieces of hardware."
The interface at reference point T is the physical and logical interface between NT1 and NT2, whenever the two NTs are implemented as separate pieces of hardware.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the second layer in the Open System Interconnection (OSI) reference model."
The Data Link layer is the second layer in the Open System Interconnection (OSI) reference model.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a network in which every node (every computer) is connected to exactly two other nodes."
The ring topology is a network in which every node (every computer) is connected to exactly two other nodes.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a technique in which each channel transmits its bits as a coded channel-specific sequence of pulses."
Code division multiplexing (CDM) is a technique in which each channel transmits its bits as a coded channel-specific sequence of pulses.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is any line, conductor, or other conduit by which information is transmitted."
A telecommunication circuit is any line, conductor, or other conduit by which information is transmitted.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is an asynchronous mode time-domain multiplexing which resembles time-division multiplexing."
Packet mode communication is an asynchronous mode time-domain multiplexing which resembles time-division multiplexing.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a digital communications technology that enables a small business or an individual to connect directly to both the Internet and other sites/users (e.g.: for videoconferencing)."

ISDN (Integrated Services Digital Network) is a digital communications technology that enables a small business or an individual to connect directly to both the Internet and other sites/users (e.g.: for videoconferencing).
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a United Nations agency that coordinates and standardises international telecommunications."
The ITU is a United Nations agency that coordinates and standardises international telecommunications.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a network in which all the nodes (called leaf nodes or peripheral nodes) are connected to a central node."
The star topology is a network in which all the nodes (called leaf nodes or peripheral nodes) are connected to a central node.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a network protocol that was developed by Apple Computer, Inc. for Macintosh computers."
Local Talk is a network protocol that was developed by Apple Computer, Inc. for Macintosh computers.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the protocol of the Internet, it has evolved based on fundamental standards that have been created and adopted over more than 30 years."
The TCP/IP is the protocol of the Internet, it has evolved based on fundamental standards that have been created and adopted over more than 30 years.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a network built by an enterprise to interconnect various company sites, e.g., production sites, head offices, remote offices, shops, in order to share computer resources."

An enterprise private network is a network built by an enterprise to interconnect various company sites, e.g., production sites, head offices, remote offices, shops, in order to share computer resources.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the basis for the Internet Protocol (IP)."
Packet switching is the basis for the Internet Protocol (IP).
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the basic unit of ISDN service."
A channel is the basic unit of ISDN service.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a wireless modem that works with a GSM wireless network."
A GSM modem is a wireless modem that works with a GSM wireless network.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is used to connect computers and other digital equipment of the organisation together."
An enterprise network is used to connect computers and other digital equipment of the organisation together.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are the fundamental units of information transport in all modern computer networks, and increasingly in other communications networks as well."
Packets are the fundamental units of information transport in all modern computer networks, and increasingly in other communications networks as well.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the sharing of Internet access, often a broadband service through a CATV or Digital Subscriber Line (DSL) provider."
An important function is the sharing of Internet access, often a broadband service through a CATV or Digital Subscriber Line (DSL) provider.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a 64-Kbps unit of clear digital bandwidth."
A B channel is a 64-Kbps unit of clear digital bandwidth.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a set of rules that governs the communications between computers on a network."
A protocol is a set of rules that governs the communications between computers on a network.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the physical and logical interface between a non-ISDN terminal device and a terminal adapter (TA)."
The interface at reference point R is the physical and logical interface between a non-ISDN terminal device and a terminal adapter (TA).
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a computer network made up of an interconnection of local area networks (LAN's) within a limited geographical area."
A campus network is a computer network made up of an interconnection of local area networks (LAN's) within a limited geographical area.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the term that describes the processes involved in designing, implementing, upgrading, managing and otherwise working with networks and network technologies."
Networking is the term that describes the processes involved in designing, implementing, upgrading, managing and otherwise working with networks and network technologies.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a common method of multiplexing, which uses optical fiber as the backbone."
Fiber in the loop (FITL) is a common method of multiplexing, which uses optical fiber as the backbone.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ means a high power signal relative to noise level, resulting in a good-quality signal."
A high SNR means a high power signal relative to noise level, resulting in a good-quality signal.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a property of a transmission medium which causes the signal to be degraded, reduced in amplitude, distorted or contaminated."
Transmission impairment is a property of a transmission medium which causes the signal to be degraded, reduced in amplitude, distorted or contaminated.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the physical and logical interface between NT (and NT2) and the ISDN carrier's local transmission loop."
The interface at reference point U is the physical and logical interface between NT (and NT2) and the ISDN carrier's local transmission loop.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a low performance type of digital modulation."
FSK is a low performance type of digital modulation.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a device that modulates an analog carrier signal to encode digital information, and also demodulates such a carrier signal to decode the transmitted information."
A modem (modulator-demodulator) is a device that modulates an analog carrier signal to encode digital information, and also demodulates such a carrier signal to decode the transmitted information.
